title: Evaluate prompt look-up as cheaper speculation - contract and fixtures

checkpoint_revision.note: same checkpoint pin as 15a; full pin is task 02

prod_decode_tok_s.note: plain decode, single request, prod flags

repetitive_workload_fraction.note: PLE locality on repetitive text; the regime where PLD can match

prose_workload_fraction.note: random/code text; PLD expected to no-op

prod_context_tokens.note: declared max; spec depth must not change the KV budget

pcie_h2d_gb_s.note: offload expert gather; rejected drafts cost verify rows

invariants: Exact speculation invariant (CONTRACTS.md): proposed tokens do not enter the stream until verify_step accepts them; on partial reject the pre-step state is restored and only the committed branch is replayed.
Greedy parity: with lookup enabled the committed token IDs are identical to plain decode for the same prompt and sampling params (the verify path is the MTP exact path).
Search work is bounded: a plan call does work O(max_ngram) map lookups and O(depth) slice copy; it never scans the whole history for a match.
Proposal length and search length are capped separately: proposal <= lookup_draft, suffix match <= lookup_ngram; the two are independent knobs.
lookup_draft and mtp_depth are mutually exclusive (ServerArgs.validate raises ValueError).
No match => plan returns 0 rows; the step is byte-identical to a plain decode row.

performance_gate.metric: median output tok/s (paired, uninstrumented, single request)
performance_gate.threshold: >=5% vs plain decode on a repetitive workload
performance_gate.guard: no regression on non-repetitive prose (drafts absent => plain row)

quality_gate.greedy: committed token IDs identical to plain decode
quality_gate.stochastic: acceptance/residual algorithm unchanged (shared spec.verify_step); fixed-logits fixture only, not token-identical across independent sampling
quality_gate.rejected_draft_cost: verify rows only; expert fetches on the offload box, no VRAM

rollback_recipe: No source change required: lookup is opt-in (lookup_draft default 0). Run the server without --lookup-draft to return to plain decode. If a code path is touched, restore via git checkout of the scope_files and re-run 17a-CMD1.
limitations: MTP is out of scope (mutually exclusive); 15b found it does not fit in 24 GiB, so lookup is the only viable draft-free route.
PLD only helps when the request repeats itself; on prose it no-ops by design, so the throughput gate is workload-conditional.
The a-phase fixtures exercise the CPU drafter and scheduler wiring only; GPU parity/throughput are b-phase (17a-C11/C12).
